neededUserActions: From a normal authorized FAOSTAT interface export QCL 2024 for all existing 34 target countries and World, for the seven remaining crop topics, preserving item/area/element codes, units, flags, notes and release metadata. Do not replace missing rows with zero.

Export FBS or SUA for a single agreed calendar year with Production/Import/Export/Stock Variation/Food/Feed/Seed/Losses/Processing/Other/Residual and definitions of primary-equivalent conversion and stock signs. Export corresponding all-reporter/all-partner trade quantity rows and World totals for the same commodity scope and period. Regional extra-regional totals require all 34 reporters and removal of within-set trade.

For forestry provide country and World production/import/export rows separately for roundwood, industrial roundwood, sawnwood and each pulp stage, plus all-partner quantities in compatible units. INFOR Chile export tables should identify product, species, period, tonnes or m3, total and all partners, distinguishing simply sawn wood from planed products and pulp subtypes.

For same-marketing-year WASDE destination comparisons provide all-partner original tables using the actual country-specific marketing-year dates. The public 2024 calendar tables must not be relabelled 2024/25.

Before public release of the added WITS/UN Comtrade and INFOR tables, verify the provider's applicable redistribution terms or provide the necessary permission. This branch and its evidence have not been published.
